content: To prevent stripping the screws give the expansion joints a twist with a pliers wrench before attempting to remove the screws.

I'm doing this upgrade on a built core 1 not from a kit. the m3x4r screws must have been put on by a gorilla, they keep stripping while trying to remove them.
I ended up busing my needle nose to remove the expansion joint (grab and twist) and a vice  to remove the screws, 3/9 came out smooth the others were stripped.

replies.content: I built mine from a kit and had the same issue. 5 out of 8 of the screws stripped when loosening.  sticking an Allen key in the side opening and twisting loosened each for me.

content: Note: "Keep the expansion joints. One of them will be reused for the nozzle wiper assembly." does not apply to indx builds
If you are using Wera hex screwdrivers to remove the screws from the expansion join the shank of the driver is too wide and you will feel  grinding feeling when trying to remove the screws

replies.content: Just grab the spacer with fingers or pliers to turn and loosen the screw, slide it off and continue with your fancy Wera tools

content: NOTE: Do not discard the expansion joints yet! One of them will be reused for the nozzle wiper.

replies.content: Good point! We should definitely include this in the instructions.
I received an additional old style expansion joint and spacer in my Gen2 kit 27691-000037
